opening.argument: The title makes a specific return promise: "50% net in Bitcoin in 1 year" in connection with BitClub, and the description provides a direct registration link for participation. The footage and narration reinforce that promotional offer by presenting mining-related equipment as operating at "full capacity" and linking the operation to an "opportunity to get salary." Taken together, these are not merely observations of equipment or an independent investigation; they present paid mining or node returns as an opportunity while directing viewers to register.
